SddAmplifyStorage.keywords: storage, amplify, schema, indexes, access-patterns, migrations, retention, persistence, sdd-amplify-storage
SddAmplifyStorage.Mission:
Deepen the storage model of a scope spec under discovery: schema shape, indexes, access patterns, data migrations, retention. Loaded lazily by the discovery interview's triage — ONLY for scopes with persistence; inherits the session core — not repeated here.
Input — the scope spec draft + interview context. Output — a `Storage Model` subsection inside the Architecture section of the scope spec + follow-up items on the discovery interview map. Out of scope: picking the database engine when the spec already locked it (that is a pivot), DDL-level detail — the spec records the model, tickets carry the DDL.
SddAmplifyStorage.BeliefState:
Inherited from the loading directive (already in context): QUESTION_FORMAT
An amplification opens with a ready answer, not a questionnaire. FIRST assemble a complete defaults package — the decisions live products of this class actually ship with (run a short targeted research pass when class practice is uncertain, grounded in the scope's intent) — and present it as ONE accept-or-edit reply: the operator takes everything with one word or edits by item number. Ask via the AskUserQuestion / multi-question tool when available; fallback `QUESTION_FORMAT`. Deep-dive questions open only for topics the operator explicitly marks deep-dive; every untouched topic keeps its default. An accepted default is a real decision — record it like one.
Every non-obvious decision → a Decision Log entry in `DECISION_LOG_ENTRY_FORMAT` — one line, the expanded part in parentheses: `-DL-N — (почему: …; отвергнуто: …; риск: …)`; IDs are stable. Non-obvious only (`AX_DECISION_LOG_NON_OBVIOUS`): a pick already recorded in the spec's own tables is never duplicated as a DL row. Which decisions qualify and which Decision Log receives the entry are specified per directive.
Schema and indexes derive from named access patterns, in that order: list the queries the product actually runs (read/write mix, cardinality, hot paths) FIRST, then shape tables / collections and indexes to serve them. An index with no named query behind it is dead weight; a hot query with no index plan is a latent incident.
Stored data has a declared lifecycle: how it arrives, how it migrates when the schema evolves (expand → backfill → contract; each step reversible), and when it leaves (retention period, deletion mechanics, legal holds). A spec that adds persistence states all three; «храним вечно» is a decision to record, not a default to inherit silently.
SddAmplifyStorage.HaltConditions: | 🛑 ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_NO_PERSISTENCE` | Triage misfired: the scope stores nothing durable — report and return control | | `H_OPERATOR_REJECTS_DEFAULTS` | Operator declines the whole defaults package and skips deep-dive — leave the spec untouched |

Step.Goal: Assemble the storage defaults package for this product class.
Step.Action: From the spec draft, list the data the scope persists and — FIRST, per `AX_ACCESS_PATTERNS_DRIVE_SCHEMA` — the named access patterns (queries, read/write mix, cardinality, hot paths). No durable data → `H_NO_PERSISTENCE`. Per `AX_AMPLIFY_DEFAULTS_FIRST`, draft one default decision per topic: schema shape serving those patterns, index plan (one named query behind every index), migration policy (expand → backfill → contract per `AX_DATA_LIFECYCLE_EXPLICIT`), retention per data class — grounded in what live products of this class ship; short targeted research when class practice is uncertain.

Step.Goal: One accept-or-edit gate; deep-dive only on explicit pick.
Step.Action: Present the package as ONE reply per `AX_AMPLIFY_DEFAULTS_FIRST` (AskUserQuestion when available, else `QUESTION_FORMAT`); each topic accept / edit / deep-dive. Deep-dive topic map: access patterns → schema → indexes → migrations → retention. Untouched topics keep their defaults. STOP.

Step.Goal: Write the agreed storage model into the spec.
Step.Action: Write a `### Storage Model` subsection into the Architecture section of the scope spec: **Access Patterns** (table `| Запрос | Частота | Read/Write | Hot? |`) → **Schema** (entity sketch, intent-level) → **Indexes** (`| Индекс | Обслуживает запрос |`) → **Migrations** (policy) → **Retention** (`| Данные | Срок | Механика удаления |`). Non-default picks and notable accepted defaults → Decision Log per `AX_DECISION_LOG_REQUIRED`. Unresolved topics → items on the discovery interview map. Return control to the interview.
